verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say its dedicated native PostgreSQL database comes with "backups, replicas, pooling, and PITR", which is a first-party claim of both backups and point-in-time recovery. That claim is a single marketing-level line scoped to the dedicated Postgres offering. Nothing in the evidence covers the managed/shared databases, storage, or self-hosted deployments. Missing for 10: confirmation that backups are automated and on what schedule, PITR retention windows and restore workflow, coverage beyond dedicated PostgreSQL (managed databases, storage, self-hosted), independent or hands-on corroboration.
